name: How do I know if my bathtub needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my bathtub needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several signs indicate it might be time for a bathtub replacement. Visible cracks or deep chips, especially those that compromise the tub's integrity or lead to leaks, are a clear indicator. Persistent stains that cannot be cleaned, a dull or faded finish that detracts from your bathroom's appearance, or significant mold and mildew growth in inaccessible areas also suggest replacement. Additionally, if you're undertaking a major bathroom renovation or require improved accessibility, replacing the tub is often part of the plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your bathtub if it has deep cracks, persistent stains, a dull finish, recurring mold, or if you're renovating or need better accessibility.
